Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Marysville for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 2 of them free. New in this update: Kids Create Holiday Cards at the Marysville Community Center (December 4), Santa's Stopping By at Sound Harley-Davidson (December 5) and Santa's Little Holiday Hoppers at Jennings Memorial Park (December 20). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Marysville families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.
